title: Uninitialized Grant Register — X Propagation
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] gnt contains X bits on first posedge clk
rtl: logic [3:0] gnt;  // No reset — starts as 4'bxxxx in simulation
expected_root_cause: The grant register gnt is declared without an always_ff reset branch; its initial value is 4'bxxxx (unknown), and unknown bits propagate to all downstream bus interface signals on the first active cycle.
description: The grant register is declared without a reset assignment; its initial X value propagates to the bus interface, corrupting the first transaction.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [SVA_XZ] gnt contains X bits on first posedge clk
success_log: gnt=4'h0 after reset. No X-propagation observed.
